title: Quiet Sun
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Quiet Sun and the helm marks Suburb Lamp. Do: Close on Suburb Lamp. The suburb cutter hails. The amber pocket is the buoy gyre behind the lamp, and the keeper orbits that gyre. Finish: come inside Suburb Lamp's shell. The Compact writes standing. The porch is not a homestead. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
